description: This file contains implementation of synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and manages thread synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Encapsulates platform-specific critical section or mutex for thread synchronization.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: Implements a binary semaphore for thread synchronization, compatible with Windows and POSIX.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a counting semaphore for managing access to a resource with a maximum count.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Provides an event synchronization object, with manual or automatic reset, for intra-process signaling.

methods.name: CriticalSection::CriticalSection
methods.description: Constructor initializing platform-specific mutex or critical section.

methods.name: CriticalSection::~CriticalSection
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up platform-specific mutex or critical section.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Acquire the binary semaphore, blocking indefinitely.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Acquire the binary semaphore with a timeout.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Acquire the semaphore with a timeout.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Release the semaphore, increasing the count.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Wait for the event to be signaled, indefinitely.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Wait for the event to be signaled with a timeout.

methods.name: Event::IsSet
methods.description: Check if the event is currently signaled.

methods.name: Event::Unlock
methods.description: Set the event to signaled state.

methods.name: Event::ResetEvent
methods.description: Reset the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: Event::SetEvent
methods.description: Set the event to signaled state, with handling for manual reset.
